_doc: Capability-band -> model routing for delegated codex/agy work. A BAND is a capability requirement with a fixed acceptance bar (see `bands`). A STANCE selects a concrete (model, effort) that still MEETS that bar - cost_first trades effort/price down but never below the band's bar; capability_first buys headroom above it. `balanced` is the canonical band set: every band a caller may request MUST exist under routes.balanced, and other stances are sparse OVERRIDES that fall back to balanced per missing cell (never across bands). claude is intentionally absent - Claude subagent effort is static frontmatter with no per-call adapter, so claude routing is an orchestrator convention (see instructions/AI.md), not resolver-enforced. agy is a SEPARATE pod with its own bands; agy.senior does NOT equal codex/main `distinguished` - never silently translate across pods.

codex.distinguished: novel or ambiguous architecture, high blast radius, correctness hard to verify by tests alone
codex.staff: multi-file feature with real design choices and moderate ambiguity
codex.senior: well-scoped feature or refactor needing some judgment
codex.engineer: mechanical or bounded change with an explicit spec
